entries.title: Live streaming voice — words appear as you speak (Deepgram Nova-3)
bullets: Added the Wispr / ChatGPT-voice tier: Deepgram Nova-3 live streaming. When active, your words render word-by-word in a live preview under the composer as you talk, then the clean final text lands in the box.
One unified voice hook that prefers live streaming and automatically falls back to gpt-4o-transcribe (PR-19) if streaming isn't available — so voice never regresses.
Security: a short-lived (~30s) token is minted server-side by the new loren-deepgram-token function, so the long-lived Deepgram key is never exposed to the browser.
Activation needs one thing: a DEEPGRAM_API_KEY secret in Supabase. Until it's added, the token endpoint returns disabled and the composer keeps using the reliable gpt-4o dictation — zero risk.
entries.bench: loren-deepgram-token (short-lived grant) · useLorenVoice (live→batch fallback) · both composers · live preview

entries.title: Real voice-to-text — talk as long as you want, get clean text
bullets: Replaced the flaky browser mic with OpenAI gpt-4o-transcribe (whisper-1 fallback). Speak for 10–20+ minutes and it transcribes cleanly.
The mic in both composers records with a live timer and drops clean text into the box on stop. Reuses your existing OpenAI key — no new account.
